# region imports
from AlgorithmImports import *
# endregion

class FutureIndexRolloverAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def initialize(self) -> None:
        self.set_start_date(2024, 9, 1)
        self.set_end_date(2024, 12, 31)
        # Filter the Futures universe by contract depth and expiry.
        self._future = self.add_future(Future.universe.Index(self._index, extended_market_hours=True))
        self._future.set_filter(0, 92)
        # Set the data mapping and normalization mode for the mapped future.
        self._future.set_data_mapping_mode(DataMappingMode.LAST_TRADING_DAY)
        self._future.set_data_normalization_mode(DataNormalizationMode.BACKWARDS_RATIO)
        # Set the contract depth offset to select the contract with the closest expiry.
        self._future.set_contract_depth_offset(0)
        # Plot the mapped future's price.
        self.plot("Future", self._future.mapped.symbol.value)

    def on_data(self, slice: Slice) -> None:
        # Create order if the mapped future has changed.
        if not self._future.mapped.invested and slice.bars.get(self._future.mapped):
            self.set_holdings(self._future.mapped, 1.0)

    def on_symbol_changed(self, symbol_changed_event: SymbolChangedEvent) -> None:
        # Manage the mapped future's quantity on expiry.
        old_symbol = symbol_changed_event.old_symbol
        new_symbol = symbol_changed_event.new_symbol
        tag = f"Rollover - {old_symbol.value} -> {new_symbol.value}"
        self.liquidate(old_symbol, tag)
        if self.portfolio.invested:
            self.set_holdings(new_symbol, self.portfolio[self._future.mapped].quantity)
